basic_details.job_title: DMHO Ri Bhoi Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 2 Laboratory Technician, Pharmacist Posts
basic_details.short_information: District Medical & Health Officer Ri Bhoi (DMHO Ri Bhoi) has announced 2 vacancies for Laboratory Technician and Pharmacist posts on a contractual basis for a period of six months only. Eligible candidates must submit their offline application by hand along with all relevant documents and testimonials in hard copy only at the Office of the District Medical & Health Officer Ri Bhoi District Nongpoh at Room 19 (Floor 1) on or before 23 October 2026 up to 5:00 PM. Applications must be submitted in hard copy only at Room 19 (Floor 1) of the designated office. Applications found incomplete in any respect will be summarily rejected. All applications will be subjected to a screening process constituted for the purpose. Shortlisted candidates for the written test and interview will be notified through the Notice Board of the Deputy Commissioner, Ri Bhoi District / District Medical & Health Officer, Ri Bhoi District, and on the official website.

faq.question: Q1. What is DMHO Ri Bhoi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notification issued by the Office of the District Medical & Health Officer Ri Bhoi District Nongpoh to fill 2 vacant posts of Laboratory Technician and Pharmacist on a contractual basis for a period of six months only at MCH Hospital Umsning.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available, with 1 vacancy for Laboratory Technician and 1 vacancy for Pharmacist.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application in hard copy is 23 October 2026 up to 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. Where should the application be submitted?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted in hard copy only at the Office of the District Medical & Health Officer Ri Bhoi District Nongpoh at Room 19 (Floor 1).

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for the posts?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for Laboratory Technician require a Bachelor in Medical Laboratory Technology (BMLT) from a recognised institution, while Pharmacist applicants require a Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharm) from a recognised institution.

faq.question: Q6. Who is eligible to apply in terms of residence?
faq.answer: Applicants should be permanent residents of Ri Bhoi District, and proof of residence must be submitted with the application.

faq.question: Q7. What is the remuneration provided for these posts?
faq.answer: The remuneration for both Laboratory Technician and Pharmacist posts is Rs. 24,000 per month.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a screening process of all applications, followed by a Written Test and an Interview for shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q9. Are these posts permanent or contractual?
faq.answer: These posts are on a contractual basis for a period of six months only.

faq.question: Q10. Where will the schedule for the written test and interview be published?
faq.answer: Details regarding the timing and venue for the written test and interview will be published on the Notice Board of the Deputy Commissioner Ri Bhoi District / District Medical & Health Officer Ri Bhoi District, and on the official websites.
